source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1967, p. 1 ("South Derry: Swatragh contest; Tullykeeran nomination; the other 24 outgoing members re-nominated"); Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1967, p. 2 ("County and rural contests (continued from page 1)")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations report, Mid-Ulster Mail 20 May 1967 p1 (image read): Swatragh is 'the contest' in South Derry; the other divisions have one nomination each (Electoral Law Act (NI) 1962: an unopposed candidate is declared elected). 'Patrick Joseph Sweeney has been nominated for the Electoral Division of Tullykeeran, in succession to Mrs. Rose O'Neill'; the Mid-Ulster Mail (20 May 1967 p2, continuation) says he 'has been returned unopposed'.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Swatragh was the only contest among the 26 seats; the other divisions were filled unopposed and their names were not printed in the reports used here. The twenty-five unopposed members added from the nominations report (Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1967, p. 1), which names 23 of them with their divisions; Ringsend and Magherafelt (the chairman and vice-chairman, re-nominated) are inferred from the 1964 return (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
